items.text: Hang Seng fell 5.7% and Shanghai Composite fell 3.1% over the past week, big moves for each. Usually a drag on Integrated Steel and Aluminium & Extrusions.
The NIFTY 500 rose 1.2% on 25 Nov. Healthcare was the strongest sector (+0.4%) and Telecommunication the weakest (−1.4%).

FIIs bought a net ₹5,673 Cr and DIIs sold a net ₹2,760 Cr of Indian shares on 23 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 70 niches; Generic & Domestic CMO, Pathology Labs and EMS & Electronic Components and others joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Travel Services & Railways Catering, Passenger Vehicles and Two Wheelers (ICE).
